title: Music video (experimental)
blurb: Verse, chorus, bridge: sung shots with the camera held still, plus wide moments. Pre-fills shots only.
status: stub: pre-fills shots only. The song -> beat map -> bar-aligned shots -> sung a2v takes -> auto-pick pipeline is not in the app yet (the demo music video was made with standalone scripts).

shots.prompt: {lead} alone in the space before the music starts, waiting for the first note.
{lead} sings the verse to camera, close, face clear and well lit.
{lead} moves with the chorus, the whole space visible around them.
The light changes; {lead} slows down and the camera comes closer.
{lead} sings the last chorus to camera, close, full energy.
{lead} lets the last note go; pull back to the whole scene.
